execute.description:
Run a flow script. Each `run_agent` call starts a step agent as a subagent; the reply is
what the script printed and returned.

generate.description:
Describe the flow you want, or a change to the current one. The agent writes it into
your editor, one edit at a time.

RunFlow.description:
A flow script to run: Python that calls `run_agent` to start step agents, in sequence
or in parallel, and returns what the last of them produced.
RunFlow.title: RunFlow

TextMessage.description: Free-form natural-language text from the user (the input to a plain chat handler).
TextMessage.title: TextMessage

TextReply.description: A free-form natural-language reply (the output of a plain chat handler).
TextReply.title: TextReply
